question: In which of the following states is the Similipal National Park located?
solution:
The correct answer is __Odisha__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Similipal Biosphere Reserve is located in the Mayurbhanj district of Odisha. 
 
• With a reserve forest area of over 2750 sq km, Similipal Wildlife Sanctuary is one of the biggest in the country.
 
• Housing a variety of wild animals, including Royal Bengal Tigers, 304 species of birds and plants, the sanctuary is extremely rich in biodiversity.
 
• The core area of Similipal Tiger Reserve extends up to 1194 sq km and the buffer area measures 1555 sq km.
